nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: At this time, another pony who had the day off that day…

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: Hey, she looks even more like you!

nodes.speaker: bowler_hat
nodes.text: Yes, right! Admit it, it was you.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: It wasn't…

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: Fine, if that's what you want,

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: Me, who had the day off that day…

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: was walking around the city and completely unaware that her

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: …me…

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: …waiting further.

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: IS THAT A BOW SHOP?

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: …Yes?

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: You have to go in there!

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: Didn't you say that this is your first story?

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: Yes, I did…

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: Then trust me as an expert in stories,

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: This story will be a hundred times better if you visit this store!

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: Perfect!

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: This is a bakery store, there are several of it in the city.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: I can buy pies in it.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: It don't make much sense right now.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: But it will come in handy in the future.

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: You're kind of strangely telling the story…

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: …as if you're there right now.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: Sorry…

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: After a while, what I described earlier in the lab happened.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: My colleagues, drugged by the potion they created, went out into the city.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: And they began to spread the virus to its inhabitants.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: I needed to get to the lab to synthesize a vaccine against it.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: And don't get infected myself.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: It has been scientifically proven that the best weapon against ponies infected with the boop-virus is pies.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: To make it even more effective, I need to bring it to the lab.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: And synthesize a vaccine using it.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: Oh no... seems like I've been booped.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: My first story didn't go at all as I had planned.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: What do you usually say? Everything was wro

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: Wait, wait

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: Let's continue from this point.

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: Your story is just beginning!

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: Are ... you sure?

nodes.speaker: pay
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: bowler_hat
nodes.text: Why not.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: ...okay

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: In the end, I managed to save everypony from a terrible boop-fate.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: A pony-chemist-scientist, who started this, never tried to play with chemicals again.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: And the lab has introduced new safety rules to prevent this from happening again.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: In the end, there wasn't a single pony left in the city that wasn't infected with the boop-virus.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: And they were all doomed to the terrible fate of forever booping each other.

nodes.speaker: dusk
nodes.text: Including... myself.
